description: Turn your agent's walls of text into interfaces you can click. Triage a milestone from rows that each carry a drafted comment and Post and close, Post, and Start thread buttons. Split one review comment into several pull requests, each waiting on its own card with its diff until you click Commit, push, and open PR. Find a design by picking from screenshots of the original and its variations, with a note on each. Requires bb 0.43 or later, and needs no account or external service.
